pages.ja: 「……臓硯の余裕かな。いつでも俺を殺せるって慢心してたのか」
pages.en: “…Maybe Zouken was simply that sure of himself. Had he grown so complacent that he thought he could kill me whenever he pleased?”

pages.ja:
「……そうね、他に理由があったんでしょうけど、衛宮くんを生かしていたのは臓硯の余裕だったのかも。
そう考えると付け込む隙にはなりそうだけど……」
pages.en:
“…Maybe. I'm sure he had some other reason, but perhaps Zouken kept you alive because he felt he had everything under control.

“If so, that very confidence may leave us an opening…”
